title: Turf War
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Turf War,' office tensions escalate over the Binghamton branch closure and client divisions. Robert makes a decisive move to restrict client contact, while Dwight and Jim plot to outmaneuver rivals. The episode features conflicts about office jurisdiction, schemes involving clients, and personal ambitions, culminating in a tense atmosphere of strategic maneuvering and unresolved threats.
